arguments.message:
Hi! Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in a timezone that comes from two places:

1. The workspace default (Settings → General).
2. Your own personal timezone (Settings → Profile).

If you’re seeing the wrong time, check your personal timezone first. Go to Settings → Profile, pick the correct timezone, and save. That will override the workspace default for you only. If you need everyone to see a different default, change the workspace default in Settings → General. Once the timezone is set correctly, the timestamps will display in the right time for you (and for others if you changed the workspace default).
